name: Syndra
notes: Opens with Unleashed Power at t=0: its effect resolves at the start of its cast per the wiki, and since no Dark Sphere has been banked yet it throws only the minimum 3 self-conjured spheres (an assumption: banking more with prior Q casts before R would only delay the rest of an 8-15 s rotation for a one-time ultimate). Its 0.25 s cast time (gen.R.castTimeS) then keeps Syndra busy, delaying the first Q/E/W cast to t=0.25.

Dark Sphere is recast the instant its cooldown allows; Unleashed Power's passive grants Dark Sphere ability haste for the whole fight once R is ranked, and Dark Sphere's 0.6 s travel delay is modeled before its area damage lands and a Dark Sphere becomes available.

Force of Will's grab (no cast time, and per the wiki not itself an ability activation) and its recast throw are modeled as one instantaneous action taken the moment a Dark Sphere is available and Force of Will is off cooldown; only the throw deals damage and triggers on-cast effects.
Scatter the Weak is cast on cooldown; its 0.25 s cast time delays its damage to the end of the cast, matching '{{Effect at cast time end}}'.

Splinters of Wrath (Transcendent) is not modeled: reaching its damage-affecting thresholds (60 stacks for Force of Will's bonus true damage, 80 for Scatter the Weak's wider cone, 100 for Unleashed Power's execute, 120 for the permanent +15% AP) from zero stacks is not realistic within an isolated 8-15 s fight, so those bonuses are omitted.

Force of Will's cooldown is read from the wiki's stated [13 to 9] (matching ddragon); Riot's raw data file carries a one-second-lower [12 to 8] for the same ability, and the wiki/ddragon-cross-checked value is used here.
Mana is not modeled: this rotation's costs are well within a level 16 Syndra's mana pool over an 8-15 s fight.
maxOrder maxes Q first for its own strong flat scaling, then W, then E; the ranked-up bonuses each unlocks under Splinters of Wrath are not reachable here so only their base damage growth matters.

assumed.why: minimum spheres Unleashed Power conjures for its opening cast, since no Dark Sphere has been banked from a prior Q cast yet
